lines.zh: 嘶鸣声中，你感受到它的冰冷气息。
lines.en: A chilling hiss as it charges.

lines.zh: 蹄声哒哒，如黑夜的低语。
黑暗中显形，它的眼眸闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Emerging from darkness, its eyes gleam with cold light.

lines.zh: 阴影中跃动，它是夜的使徒。
lines.en: Shadows moving, an emissary of the night.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，幽灵般地逼近。
lines.en: A hiss as it closes in, like a ghost.
A dark roar, breaking the silence.

lines.zh: 铁蹄踏地，冰寒渗入骨髓。
lines.en: Iron hooves strike, icy cold seeping into bones.

lines.zh: 黑暗中显现，它的眼中满是怨念。
lines.en: Eyes glowing in darkness, filled with spite.
My hooves never touch ground, only drift.
My kin and I form a single line.

lines.zh: 静静地伫立，仿佛黑夜的一部分。
lines.en: Stands silently, a part of the night.

lines.zh: 幽灵般的存在，难以捉摸。

lines.en: Standing still, waiting for the call.

lines.zh: 静静地驻立，凝视着远方。
lines.en: Standing quietly, gazing into the distance.

lines.zh: 漆黑的轮廓，在夜色中隐现。
lines.en: Black outline, flickering in the night.

lines.zh: 静静驻立，仿佛从未存在。
lines.en: Standing quietly, as if never here.

lines.zh: 漆黑中，几乎察觉不到它的存在。
它的眼睛盯上你，仿佛要吞噬你的灵魂。
lines.en: Its eyes lock onto you, as if to devour your soul.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着贪婪，盯住你。
lines.en: Eyes gleam with greed, fixing on you.
It gazes at you, full of spite.

lines.zh: 它的眼中充满怨恨，盯着你。
lines.en: Eyes full of hatred, staring at you.
Locks onto you, with ill intent.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着你，充满杀意。
lines.en: Eyes fix on you, with murderous intent.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中透出死亡的气息。
lines.en: Its eyes emit a deathly aura.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，怨念在眼中燃烧。
lines.en: Staring at you, hatred burning in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛仿佛要穿透你。
它的眼睛中透出死亡的阴影。
lines.en: Eyes emit the shadow of death.
Black shadow weak, fights for life.

lines.zh: 嘶鸣着靠近你，黑恰罗的召唤物！
lines.en: Snorting as it nears you, Black Zahro’s summoning!

lines.zh: 我来带你游荡于幽暗之地！
lines.en: Let me take you through the darklands!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的缰绳，你会爱上我的！
lines.en: Feel my reins, and you’ll love me!

lines.zh: 我的速度能让你心惊胆战！
lines.en: My speed will send shivers down your spine!

lines.zh: 加入我的行列，黑恰罗的骑士！
我的嘶鸣是战场上的号角！
lines.en: My snort is the battle’s horn!

lines.zh: 跟随着我，穿越黑暗的迷雾！
lines.en: Follow me, through the dark fog!

lines.zh: 感受我的力量，就像黑恰罗！
黑恰罗的幽灵马，你的伴侣！
lines.en: Black Zahro’s ghost horse, your companion!

lines.zh: 冲向你的那一刻，就是死亡来临！
与我相撞，便是永恒的静止！
lines.en: Collide with me, and cease to be!
Fall under my snort of death!

lines.zh: 避不开我的冲锋，只有毁灭！

lines.en: Collide with me, and your soul vanishes!

lines.zh: 与我交配，感受死亡的温暖！
lines.en: Mate with me, feel death’s warmth!

lines.zh: 与我交配，共享死亡之旅！
lines.en: Mate with me, share the deathly journey!

lines.zh: 与我交配，成为永恒的伴侣！
与我交配，体验死亡的甜蜜！
lines.en: Mate with me, taste death’s sweetness!

lines.zh: 与我交配，成为不死之身！
与我交配，共享死亡的呼吸！
lines.en: Mate with me, share the breath of death!

lines.zh: 蹄子踏过战场，成排而来。
lines.en: Hooves cross the field in ranks.

lines.zh: 我踏着黑恰罗的号令起步。
lines.en: I break into motion at Chicharo's command.
My charge goes straight, no turning.

lines.zh: 阵型排好了，你躲不过第二波。
lines.en: The formation is set; you cannot dodge the second wave.

lines.zh: 网格排好了，下一波有我。
lines.en: The grid is set; I'm in the next wave.
The formation is set. Here I charge.
The formation is set, first a single charge.
The scent of the living lies ahead.
We have lined up in a rank.
I give everyone a warning first.
When the bell sounds, I move.
This pass is a straight line.
I lower my neck and prepare to run.
Hold your position. Do not stray.
My shadow charges ahead of me.

lines.zh: 冲锋前的三息，你自己数。
lines.en: Three breaths before the charge, count them yourself.

lines.zh: 我从你背后那列冲过来。
lines.en: I charge from the column behind you.
I pass along your left side.
My iron hooves shatter the ground.
I gallop on without looking back.
The next pass comes from the other side.
A cold wind grazes your face.
We cross over, leaving no gap.
A drum of hooves, and I am past.

lines.zh: 蹄声先在黑暗里响起来。
lines.en: Hooves sound in the dark before I appear.
Chacharo raises a hand and I take shape.
The mist thickens into a horse's body.
I take my place in the formation.
The horn has not sounded, yet I am ready.

lines.zh: 这具骨头太饿，跑不快了。
lines.en: These bones are too hungry to run.
